text:
Priya Singh: Quick flag - two interviewers reported they couldn't see past interviewer's notes in the new scorecard UI after the ATS schema change. They only see the latest blank scorecard.

Raj Patel: Thanks. Is this about permissions or a rendering bug?

Omar Ali: I dug in. The new profile view paginates notes under /profiles/{id}/activity but the scorecard embed was pointing at /profiles/{id}/latest_scorecard which got removed. So the iframe loads nothing.

Maya Chen: Can we fallback to activity view until a proper migration mapping is added? We need interviewers to see previous notes when calibrating scores.

ats-admin-bot: Available quick fixes: (A) change embed to /profiles/{id}/activity#scorecards, (B) re-provision legacy endpoint as compatibility shim, (C) send a non-embedded link to open the scorecards in a new tab.

Priya Singh: Option C is fastest and least risky. If we update the interviewer reminder template to include the direct activity link, interviewers can still access prior notes.

Raj Patel: Agree. Integrations - can you update the template variable to use {{profile_activity_url}} and send a follow-up to the affected interviewers?

ats-admin-bot: Template updated to include {{profile_activity_url}}. Twenty reminders affected earlier today; follow-up note queued.

Omar Ali: I'll file a tech task to re-add the compatibility shim and add an automated test verifying scorecard embeds render for a sample profile.

Maya Chen: Also add a quick note in the interviewer onboarding doc about where to find previous notes under the new UI. Priya, can you update training?

Priya Singh: On it. I'll add a screenshot + two bullets and drop it in the new-hire SOP.

Raj Patel: Follow-up sent to 20 interviewers at 14:12 UTC with activity links. Monitoring for any more reports.

Maya Chen: Thanks, team. Let's make the embed test part of the migration checklist so this doesn't recur. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
